title: Several exclusion tests pass without applying their exclusion patterns
reasoning: The fixtures register only .py files, but these exclusion scenarios place unsupported .pyc or extensionless files in the excluded locations. Unsupported-extension filtering alone produces the asserted results, so the tests cannot detect broken __pycache__, .git, *.pyc, or default-pattern handling.
reproduction: Make the relevant exclusion patterns ineffective while retaining supported-extension filtering; these scenarios still produce the same measured files.
recommendation: Use supported .py files inside excluded directories. For extension-glob tests, register the excluded extension and establish that the file is measured without the pattern. Exercise default exclusions with a supported file inside a default-excluded directory.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Other scenarios cover some directory exclusions, but the cited scenarios do not distinguish their intended exclusion rule from language filtering.
suggestedRegressionTest: Expand the existing exclusion scenarios to compare results with and without each explicit pattern and to verify default exclusion of otherwise measurable files.
minimumFixScope: The exclusion fixtures and scenarios in tests/metrics/driver_test.py.

history.reasoning: The evidence file and original scenarios still exist, with shifted lines. Current coverage appears to repair the substantive gap: lines 146–156 register .pyc; lines 318–333 establish measurement before applying *.pyc; lines 360–383 independently test directory exclusions using supported .py files; lines 560–574 verify default exclusion of an otherwise measurable file. The older .git and snapshot-pattern scenarios remain individually weak, but the new scenarios cover their missing behavioral rules. Production code applies component-wise patterns and includes the expected defaults. No linked patch attempts were supplied. Targeted validation exited 2 because sandbox permissions prevented uv cache access, so a fixed outcome cannot be confirmed.
commands: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --no-sync pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/metrics/driver_test.py -k 'exclu'

history.note: Verified explicit and default exclusion tests use otherwise measurable supported files and compare without patterns; 123 tests pass.
